data.name: RG_ICE_01
data.value: This chamber is colder than the corridor.[pause=25] Far colder.[pause=20] Frost is climbing the walls,[pause=10] and climbing fast.

data.name: RG_ICE_02
data.value: Can you see your breath?[pause=20] I can.[pause=25] A second ago,[pause=10] I couldn't.

data.name: RG_ICE_03
data.value: YOU GATHERED THE SIGNS.[pause=25] NO ONE HAS DONE THAT SINCE...[pause=30] I NO LONGER KNOW.[pause=20] THE COUNT WAS LOST WITH THE REST.

data.name: RG_ICE_04
data.value: (He isn't threatening us.[pause=20] He's stating a fact.[pause=25] That's almost worse.)

data.name: RG_ICE_05
data.value: He won't step aside.[pause=20] And we're not leaving without getting through.[pause=25] Stay close to me.

data.name: RG_ROCK_01
data.value: The floor shudders at steady intervals.[pause=25] That's no rockfall.[pause=20] That's a rhythm.

data.name: RG_ROCK_02
data.value: It's coming from the back...[pause=20] and rising from below,[pause=10] not from the sides.

data.name: RG_ROCK_03
data.value: STONE REMEMBERS EVERY STEP.[pause=25] YOURS ARE NEW.[pause=20] VERY NEW.[pause=30] SHOW ME THEY CARRY WEIGHT.

data.name: RG_ROCK_04
data.value: (He heard us coming from the first floor.[pause=25] He simply waited for us to reach him.)

data.name: RG_ROCK_05
data.value: Fine.[pause=20] Then we'll carry weight.[pause=25] We didn't come all this way to back down from a rock,[pause=10] however big.

data.name: RG_STEEL_01
data.value: Nothing.[pause=30] No cold,[pause=10] no tremor,[pause=10] not a sound.[pause=25] Just an empty chamber.

data.name: RG_STEEL_02
data.value: ...That's what bothers me.[pause=25] The other two announced themselves.[pause=20] This one,[pause=15] didn't.

data.name: RG_STEEL_03
data.value: I DID NOT SLEEP.[pause=30] I STOOD WHILE THE OTHER TWO RESTED.[pause=25] SOMEONE HAD TO WATCH THE DOOR.

data.name: RG_STEEL_04
data.value: (He was here all along.[pause=25] We turned our backs on him walking in.)

data.name: RG_STEEL_05
data.value: He let us come this far.[pause=25] That wasn't carelessness.[pause=20] It was a test,[pause=10] and it starts now.

data.name: RG_VICTOIRE
data.value: The guardian goes still,[pause=20] then slowly folds in on itself.[pause=25] Where it stood,[pause=15] the way is open.

data.name: RG_VICTOIRE_P
data.value: It didn't collapse...[pause=20] it stood down.[pause=25] Like its watch had just ended.

data.name: RG_DEFAITE
data.value: The floor gives way.[pause=25] The guardian doesn't pursue:[pause=15] it simply returns to its post,[pause=10] and waits.

data.name: RG_DEFAITE_P
data.value: We got thrown out...[pause=20] but it didn't finish us.[pause=25] It's waiting for us to come back ready.[pause=20] So let's go back.
